assertions.assertion: Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring was performed under CPT 93229
The patient presents with intermittent palpitations
The patient has a history of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
The service was ordered to correlate symptomatic episodes with underlying arrhythmias
The service was ordered to assess for ischemic changes
The patient has documented cardiac history
Precertification for CPT 93229 was appropriate to determine coverage eligibility
Precertification is required by SilverBridge Advantage
The claim was denied under Reason Code CO-197
The denial was for lack of precertification
The appeal requests that the denial be reversed on the basis of the documented clinical indication
